article_XXXVI_text.article_text:
No experiment result may change candidate belief unless ALL of the following 7 conditions are mechanically verified:

1. PRE_REGISTRATION_VALID: A pre-registration file exists, is hash-pinned, and was committed BEFORE the experiment script was executed.

2. IMPLEMENTATION_MATCHES_PROTOCOL: The experiment script implements EXACTLY what the pre-registration specifies. No substitution of algorithms, no simplification of models, no skipped components.

3. BASELINE_FAIR: The baseline is the strongest publicly plausible alternative, not a strawman. Baseline parameters are pre-registered and frozen. Baseline implementation is calibrated against published performance.

4. NO_DATA_LEAKAGE: The candidate does not have access to information that the baseline lacks. Train/test split is pre-registered and enforced. No post-hoc data selection.

5. THRESHOLDS_FROZEN: All decision thresholds (WIN, KILL, MMD) are pre-registered with provenance chains. No threshold is changed after experiment execution.

6. MODEL_SPECIFICATION_FROZEN: All model hyperparameters (controller gains, filter coefficients, learning rates, etc.) are pre-registered. No hyperparameter is tuned after seeing results.

7. RANDOM_SEED_COHORT_PROVENANCE_COMPLETE: Random seed is pre-registered and frozen. Cohort generation is reproducible. No re-running with different seeds and reporting only the best.

If any condition fails, the experiment is INVALID and candidate state is UNCHANGED. The results are preserved as historical evidence about implementation behavior, but cannot update candidate belief.

This article is enforced mechanically (pre-commit hook + CI), not procedurally.

four_epistemic_states.VALIDATED_POSITIVE: All 7 conditions pass AND results meet WIN thresholds → candidate may promote
four_epistemic_states.VALIDATED_NEGATIVE: All 7 conditions pass AND results meet KILL thresholds → candidate may demote/kill
four_epistemic_states.EXPERIMENT_INVALID: Any of 7 conditions fail → candidate state UNCHANGED. Results are historical implementation evidence, not scientific evidence.
four_epistemic_states.INFRASTRUCTURE_BLOCKED: Experiment cannot execute (external dependency missing) → candidate state UNCHANGED. No epistemic update.

what_this_changes.before_ratification: Round 159 used the validity gate as an ENFORCED_IMPLEMENTATION_RULE — the coder followed it voluntarily, but it was not a constitutional requirement.
what_this_changes.after_ratification: Round 160 and forward: the validity gate is a CONSTITUTIONAL_ARTICLE. Violating it is a constitutional violation, not just a procedural error. The distinction matters for governance: constitutional violations require formal remediation (PCP), while procedural errors just need correction.
what_this_changes.practical_impact: Any future experiment that fails the validity gate MUST be recorded as EXPERIMENT_INVALID. The candidate state CANNOT change. This is now mechanically enforced, not just procedurally encouraged.
